lines.text: Deep in your skin, right now, a new cell is being born.
It starts at the very bottom… and slowly begins to rise.
As it climbs, it fills with a tough protein called keratin. It grows flatter… and flatter.
Near the top, it lets go of its nucleus… and its life gently ends.
So the skin you can touch right now is made of cells that have finished their lives.
Stacked like bricks, they seal in water.
The whole journey takes about a month.
Then, quietly, the top cells drift away, far too small to see. Some of the dust in your home… began as you.
Underneath, new cells are already rising. Always rebuilding… from the bottom up.
